claims: The Philadelphia Flyers have clinched a spot in the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs.
The Philadelphia Flyers ended a five-season drought.
The Philadelphia Flyers will face the Pittsburgh Penguins in the Eastern Conference First Round.
The Philadelphia Flyers secured the third seed in the Metropolitan Division.
The Philadelphia Flyers will begin their series on the road against the Pittsburgh Penguins.
The Pittsburgh Penguins hold home-ice advantage.
The matchup is No. 3 Philadelphia Flyers vs. No. 2 Pittsburgh Penguins (Metro Division).
The status was confirmed on April 13, 2026, following a 3-2 shootout win against the Hurricanes.
